subject: Next steps: lock demo + dedicated sizing cadence
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@brightline.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + proposed next step (dedicated sizing)

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap from our side:

- Brightline uses the recommendation pipeline in prod for customer-facing results (~12–15s avg response today)
- Primary goal: reduce p95/p99 tail and get predictable per-request cost for peak batch periods
- Workload shape: mix of short text (<=128 tokens) and occasional long-form (<=1024 tokens) inference; we expect bursts during morning batch windows

Recommended next step: schedule a 60–90 minute dedicated sizing session (Redwood SE + your infra lead) to walk throughput profile, target latencies (p50/p95/p99), and agree on an initial GPU pool configuration. During that session we will:

- Review your load profile and concurrency targets
- Validate sequence length distributions and KV cache needs
- Recommend batch & quantization profiles and an initial GPU allocation
- Produce a one-page action list (rollout/canary plan + target SLOs)

Can you share two windows that work next week (US/PST preferred) and the best technical contact to invite? I attached a short checklist you can fill out ahead of the call — it will let us come prepared.

Attachments: redwood-sizing-checklist.pdf

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn_hart@redwood.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0144

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@brightline.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@brightline.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed next step (dedicated sizing)

Thanks, Evelyn —

Appreciate the succinct summary. Priya (ops) and I reviewed the checklist and attached a preliminary load file. High level:

- Typical steady-state QPS: 4–6 (latency sensitive)
- Peak batch windows: up to ~600 inferences/min for short texts (10–12s/req today)
- Spike scenario (big dataset push): up to 3k inferences/min for ~30 minutes
- Latency targets: p95 < 300ms, p99 < 800ms for short text paths

We attached brightline-load-profile.csv with anonymized traces. For the technical contact, please loop in our infra lead: Rahul Menon (rahul.m@brightline.ai).

We can do either of these windows:
- Tue, 30 May, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed, 31 May, 08:30–10:00 PT

If you can confirm a slot, we’ll get Rahul + Priya on the invite.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of ML Ops | Brightline AI

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@brightline.ai>, Priya Desai <priya@brightline.ai>, Rahul Menon <rahul.m@brightline.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed next step (dedicated sizing)

Great — thanks for the file and the windows. Karthik (SE) and I can take the sizing session. Proposed slot: Tue, 30 May, 10:00–11:30 PT — 90 minutes so we have time for validation and buffer.

Meeting agenda (proposed)
1) 10m introductions + success criteria
2) 20m walkthrough of brightline-load-profile.csv and key metrics
3) 25m throughput / latency modeling + sensible GPU pool suggestions
4) 20m runbook & rollout recommendations (canaries, fallbacks)
5) 15m open questions + next steps

Prep requests (short):
- If you can mark the CSV with which rows are production vs. test traces, that helps us prioritize.
- Any compliance constraints (data residency, retention windows) — mention if non-standard.

Calendar link to confirm: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-demo

I’ve attached the redwood-sizing-checklist we sent earlier and a quick sample of what the one-page output looks like.

We’ll also add a short HubSpot note to the deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123/deal/DL-2028-BR-0021

If that slot works, I’ll send a formal invite and a short pre-call form for Rahul.

Cheers,
Evelyn
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Rahul Menon <rahul.m@brightline.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@brightline.ai>, Priya Desai <priya@brightline.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed next step (dedicated sizing)

Thanks — Tue 30th 10:00–11:30 PT works for me. I uploaded a short environment note to the shared drive and added two rows to the CSV marking prod vs. test traces.

Quick FYI for the call: our current infra team horizon includes a temporary SLO breach tolerance during the migration window; we want to understand rollback/fallback options clearly. Looking forward to the session — I’ll be on the invite.

Regards,
Rahul Menon
Infra Lead | Brightline AI
